# Conformant Kubernetes API objects — identical behavior on
# AKS, EKS, GKE, and on-prem (kubeadm, OpenShift, Rancher):
#
#   Deployment, Service, ConfigMap, Secret, PVC
#
# kubectl apply -f order-service.yaml
# behaves THE SAME regardless of which cloud runs the control plane
caption: The object you declare is the unit of portability, not the cluster or cloud account.

code:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels: { app: order-service }
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: { app: order-service }
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/order-service:1.4.2
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: 8080 }
caption: Nothing in this manifest names a cloud — it's the same on AKS, EKS, or on-prem.
